source_research.title: Momentum effects in the cryptocurrency market after one-day abnormal returns
source_research.extracted_mechanism: After an unusually large current-day move relative to recent completed-day volatility, directional order-flow/behavioral continuation may persist through the remainder of the same UTC day.
source_research.adaptation_note: The source used asset-specific abnormal-return coefficients and reported results without our cost model. This replication deliberately freezes one common coefficient for all assets, uses point-in-time trailing completed days, next-bar execution, realistic costs, and our own chronological selection evidence.

scientific_hypothesis.economic_mechanism: Large intraday moves that are extreme relative to a point-in-time distribution of completed daily returns can reflect persistent information/order-flow rather than a completed one-off shock; if the move is genuinely persistent, same-direction continuation through the remaining UTC day should survive next-open execution and costs.
scientific_hypothesis.falsifiable_claim: The first intraday crossing of a fixed 1.5-sigma abnormal daily-return boundary has positive same-direction after-cost expectancy from the next completed 1h bar open through the next UTC-day 00:00 open, in both training and validation, and adds economic value over simple same-window one-hour momentum and outcome-blind placebos.

signal_rules.intraday_return_definition: at completed hourly bar t: close_t / open_00:00_of_same_UTC_day - 1
signal_rules.reference_mean_and_std: sample mean and sample standard deviation of the immediately preceding 90 fully observed completed UTC-day returns for the same instrument; current day excluded
signal_rules.trigger_occurrence: first qualifying completed hourly bar per instrument per UTC day only
signal_rules.missing_or_incomplete_reference_day: exclude that day from the 90-day reference window; no interpolation; signal day itself must have continuous bars from 00:00 through decision time

execution_rules.entry: next completed 1h bar open after the qualifying signal
execution_rules.direction: same sign as qualifying abnormal intraday return
execution_rules.event_independence: at most one event per instrument per UTC day; pooled inference must additionally report UTC-day clustered results

cost_model.funding_note: This v1 freezes a conservative fixed adverse funding allowance rather than reading future realized funding. If authenticated PIT funding data later becomes available, changing this assumption requires a newly frozen version before outcomes.

cheap_stage_gates.underpowered_action: classify UNDERPOWERED via #510; do not lower sigma threshold, shorten reference window, extend protected period, or create parameter variants

baseline_and_ablation_plan.primary_mechanism_baseline: On the exact candidate event windows, trade the sign of the immediately preceding completed 1h close-to-close return instead of the abnormal current-day cumulative-return direction; same next-open entry, same midnight exit, same costs.
baseline_and_ablation_plan.sign_flip_falsifier: Trade opposite the candidate direction on the exact candidate event windows; same entry/exit/costs.
baseline_and_ablation_plan.one_bar_delay: Delay candidate entry by exactly one completed 1h bar while preserving original signal direction and midnight exit; events with no remaining valid holding interval are omitted under a predeclared symmetric rule and counted.
baseline_and_ablation_plan.randomized_timing_placebo: Use #517/#523 deterministic frequency- and direction-matched eligible-window randomization separately in training and validation, without reading forward returns during schedule formation.
baseline_and_ablation_plan.ablation: Candidate event schedule and direction without the 1.5-sigma abnormality requirement is not permitted post hoc; the mechanism gate is instead tested by the frozen randomized eligible-window placebo and the simple one-hour-momentum baseline.
baseline_and_ablation_plan.complexity_rule: Reject/deprioritize if the candidate does not beat the primary simple baseline after costs in both training and validation or if placebo/delayed controls explain the result.

successive_halving.stage_1: development-only cheap chronological train+validation screen through 2026-08-31T23:00:00Z
successive_halving.stage_2: only if Stage 1 survives: run frozen #517 baseline/placebo/ablation gauntlet and medium stability checks
successive_halving.stage_3: at most one global Strategy Factory deep candidate may advance; this replication has no special promotion priority
